description: Returns the Market Eyes Live public forward-testing record: since when ratings have been captured and graded, how many calls, tickers and graded outcomes, and for each published tier (Favorable and Highest Conviction are recorded together as one favorable tier; Hold; Unfavorable; Rising Star, Very Promising, Promising; Runner!; Catalyst Watch) the share of calls that beat more than half of the other core stocks rated the same day over the next day, week and month, with the calls behind each figure and the 50% no skill line, plus the same against same day core stocks in the same industry where published. Use this when the person asks how accurate or how tested Market Eyes Live ratings are, for example 'what is Market Eyes Live's track record' or 'how often are its favorable ratings right'. Do not use for a single ticker's rating (check_trade carries the record for its tier). Limitations: read from the public feed at https://marketeyeslive.com/api/validation-status, which publishes a cell only once it holds 20 graded outcomes across 8 tickers; a copy is cached for up to 15 minutes and rebuilt on the next read after that, and an older copy, up to about a day old, may answer while a new one builds or while the feed cannot be read (the result carries its last capture date); captures are immutable and grading is automatic. Method: https://marketeyeslive.com/how-melany-is-tested.html. Research data, not financial advice; past results do not guarantee future results; read-only.
name: get_track_record

outputSchema.description: the public record; omitted when the feed could not be read in time, which returns a text message instead

headline.description: the favorable tier at one month, in one sentence

beat_same_day_list.description: 0 to 1: share of calls that beat more than half of the same day list

beat_sector_peers.description: 0 to 1: the same against same day core stocks in the same industry

tier.description: the published word, the two favorable words recorded together, or a REIT label (a REIT is recorded under the app's own label)

title: Get the public graded record
